split: Each series: first60% train, next20% validation, final20% test; no point adjustment; same common-valid-point mask for both detectors
label_source: Official CSV Label column, retained unchanged; conflicting annotations excluded rather than changed

median_mad.selection: F1 on chronological validation only; frozen before held-out scoring
median_mad.delay_limitation: Conditional on detected labelled events; undetected events remain false negatives. Source-local time differences only when timezone is absent.

forecast_residual.selection: F1 on chronological validation only; frozen before held-out scoring
forecast_residual.delay_limitation: Conditional on detected labelled events; undetected events remain false negatives. Source-local time differences only when timezone is absent.
